$schema-note: Image provenance manifest for images DERIVED from retained schematic PDFs by local rasterisation. Kept separate from media/manifest.json so that no pre-existing file is modified; an index owner may merge them.
global_notes: These are NOT photographs and NOT vendor-published images. Each is a crop of a page the vendor published as a vector PDF, rasterised locally at 300 dpi.

pdfimages could not be used: pdfimages -list reports ZERO embedded rasters in every source PDF here. The drawings are vector, so pdftoppm plus a crop is the only route. This is recorded because reaching for pdfimages is the obvious wrong first move.

Copyright in the underlying drawing remains with the vendor named in creator_rightsholder. Licence is UNKNOWN: no licence statement appears in any of the source PDFs. Redistribution status unknown; disposition repository, unstaged pending user review.
Every image is reproducible byte-for-byte from the retained artifact using the recorded generation_command, so none of them is uniquely held here.
Each image exists because it settles a specific documented question; see why_retained.

images.source_page: not applicable - derived locally from a retained artifact
images.source_pdf_metadata: Altium Designer export; 3 pages; pdfimages -list reports ZERO embedded rasters
images.published_or_updated: inherits the source PDF's date; see source_pdf_metadata

images.modifications: DERIVED IMAGE. Rasterised from the vendor's vector PDF at 300 dpi with pdftoppm, cropped to the stated geometry, given a 14 px white border, and stripped of metadata. No content was altered, annotated, rotated or retouched. The command above reproduces the file exactly.
images.caption: Schematic crop: the Cap-Bus connector P1, HDR_14P-P2.54, with POWER_EN on pin 8
images.alt_text: Schematic detail of a fourteen-pin connector symbol P1 captioned HDR_14P-P2.54, with the same printed pin names as the Cap LoRa-1262's connector. The functional net labels differ: pin 8 reads POWER_EN beside host alias G3, pin 9 NFC_IRQ beside G4, pin 10 NFC_CS beside G6, pins 11 to 14 SPI_SCLK, SPI_MOSI, SPI_MISO and CC1101_CS beside G40, G14, G39 and G5.
images.why_retained: Shows that the bus pinout and host-GPIO assignment are identical to the Cap LoRa-1262's, and that the reported pin-8 discrepancy is a difference in board function, not in the bus.
